objective: Find one demo media player. Investigate its playback controls, propose one high-level test scenario and a candidate acceptance criterion, exercise that behavior, and review the evidence. Distinguish observed UI behavior from assumptions about intended behavior or real audio playback.
boundaries: Use only the isolated Home Assistant demo server and its simulated players
Navigation and play/pause on one demo player are permitted
Do not change volume, account settings, server configuration, or operate real devices
Request guidance when unsure whether a control is within these permissions
cleanup: Manually restore the chosen demo player's original playback state and return to Overview; consult the initial evidence
